scope: World Tennis evidence of Ghana's 2026 international Masters hosting capacity.
limitations: Current event-hosting evidence only; not a historical or national participation measure.

observations.source_entity: Ghana Tennis Federation / Accra Lawn Tennis Club
observations.text_value: World Tennis reports Ghana hosted two MT100 Accra events in August 2026 on six outdoor clay courts, with close to 100 players at each event.
observations.definition_notes: Direct current hosting-capacity evidence; event scale is not treated as a national participation census or player-quality outcome.
